# Provectus

> > Provectus is an AI consultancy and solutions provider specializing in enterprise AI/ML transformation, MLOps infrastructure, and generative AI implementations on AWS.

Provectus partners with leading technology companies like AWS and Anthropic to deliver machine learning infrastructure, computer vision, fraud detection, and GenAI solutions across healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, and digital media industries. The company offers proprietary frameworks like the AI/ML Transformation Canvas and Crystal Engine for customer behavior prediction.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning Infrastructure & MLOps
- AWS AI/ML Services (Lookout for Vision, Lookout for Metrics, Panorama)
- Anthropic Claude & Claude for Healthcare
- Generative AI & LLM Solutions
- Computer Vision & Anomaly Detection
- Fraud Detection & Data Quality
- Feature Stores & ML Operations
- Enterprise AI Transformation
- Healthcare AI (HIPAA-compliant, PubMed, ICD-10)
- Digital Banking & Financial Services AI
- Manufacturing & Industrial AI
- Customer Behavior Prediction & Personalization
- AI Team Building & People Management
- Streaming Data Platforms
- Synthetic Data Generation

## Core AI/ML Solutions & Infrastructure

- [Machine Learning Infrastructure — Foundation for AI Projects](https://provectus.com/machine-learning-infrastructure): Cloud-native ML infrastructure solution with MLOps, feature store & monitoring
- [The Provectus AI/ML Transformation Canvas](https://provectus.com/the-provectus-ai-ml-transformation-canvas): Provectus methodology framework for enterprise AI/ML transformation
- [GenAI Solution: AI Customer Support Agent](https://provectus.com/generative-ai-center-of-excellence/ai-customer-support-agent): LLM-powered AI agent for automated customer support ticket resolution
- [Provectus Launches ML-powered Crystal Engine](https://provectus.com/blog/provectus-launches-crystal-engine-a-product-for-ml-based-customer-behavior-prediction-and-personalization): Crystal Engine launch: ML solution for customer behavior & personalization

- [Optimizing Healthcare Staffing and Care Delivery with Data & AI/ML](https://provectus.com/case-studies/optimizing-healthcare-staffing-care-delivery-ai-ml-data): Gale Healthcare case study: ML shift prediction for nurse staffing optimization
